title: Upload to tidepool crashes new upgrade AAPS 3.2-rc1
body:
I've been waiting for tidepool support for a while. ;)

Just upgraded to rc1 and got everything else setup.  Plugin itemizes what needs to be uploaded, assembles it then right after upload begins the app crashes.  This has happened 4 times consecutively before I disabled tidepool.

Log attached, at least a couple crashes should be in there. 
Build: dd6081efd2-2023.10.03
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 15.0.0

[AndroidAPS._2023-10-03_15-54-04_.34.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12797268/AndroidAPS._2023-10-03_15-54-04_.34.zip)

comments.body:
log doesn't contain any crash
replicate the issue, update with new logs and time of occurence
make sure the time is in logs

Will do.
